class="Le88gL comp-mly0zb9g wixui-section" data-block-level-container="ClassicSection"><div id="bgLayers_comp-mly0zb9g" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-mly0zb9g" class="QG9w8P"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="LNYVZi ayCf9D"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-mly0zb9g" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-mly0zb9g" class="ROWgFb"></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-mly0zb9ginlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-mly0zb9ginlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-mly0zb9h7" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mly0zb9h7 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h1 class="font_0 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:56px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:56px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Madagascar</span></span></h1></div><div id="comp-mly0zb9q1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mly0zb9q1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px;">20-28&nbsp; June</p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:center; font-size:16px;">9 days (8nights)</p></div><div id="comp-mly0zb9r5" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mly0zb9r5 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">Madagascar is an exceptional kitesurfing destination known for its steady trade winds, warm waters, and uncrowded spots.</p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">The island offers a mix of flat-water lagoons and wave riding, especially around areas like Diego Suarez, Sakalava Bay, and Babaomby.</p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">With consistent wind during much of the year, tropical scenery, and a relaxed, off-the-beaten-path vibe, Madagascar is ideal for riders looking for both high-quality conditions and adventure beyond the water.</p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:normal; text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:normal; text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="https://www.travelactiveclub.com/copy-of-brazil-1-1" target="_self" data-anchor="anchors-m4orjln01" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Spot and Wind Conditions</a></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:normal; text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="https://www.travelactiveclub.com/copy-of-brazil-1-1" target="_self" data-anchor="dataItem-m5r1j1tr" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Plan of the Trip</a></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:normal; text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="https://www.travelactiveclub.com/copy-of-brazil-1-1" target="_self" data-anchor="anchors-m4orjlnf9" class="wixui-rich-text__text">What is included</a></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:normal; text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="https://www.travelactiveclub.com/copy-of-brazil-1-1" target="_self" data-anchor="anchors-m4orjln98" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Price</span></a></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:normal; text-align:center; font-size:16px;"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p></div></div></div></section><section id="comp-mly0zb9v4" tabindex="-1" class="Le88gL comp-mly0zb9v4 wixui-section" data-mesh-id="comp-mly0zbaj1inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-mly0zbaj1inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-mly0zban1" class="qe3oTb ignore-focus comp-mly0zban1" role="region" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Plan of the Trip"><div id="planofthetrip"></div><span class="TvbeET">Plan of the Trip</span></div><section id="comp-mly0zbap3" class="comp-mly0zbap3 CeUMmm wixui-column-strip"><div id="bgLayers_comp-mly0zbap3" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-mly0zbap3" class="ktMZav"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="V9k0ll etGVsi"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-mly0zbap3" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-mly0zbap3" class="etSQ9j"></div></div><div data-testid="columns" class="Ak0vpt"><div id="comp-mly0zbb0" class="comp-mly0zbb0 FDI5TK wixui-column-strip__column"><div id="bgLayers_comp-mly0zbb0" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-mly0zbb0" class="QG9w8P"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="LNYVZi ayCf9D"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-mly0zbb0" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-mly0zbb0" class="ROWgFb"></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-mly0zbb0inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-mly0zbb0inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-mly0zbb1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mly0zbb1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h5 class="font_5 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:24px;"><span style="font-size:24px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Spot and wind conditions​</span></span></h5>
<h5 class="font_5 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></h5>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Main wind season runs from April through November, peaking between June and September. Wind Strength: Generally 15&ndash;35+ knots during the trade wind season. Early/late season you&rsquo;ll see ~12&ndash;25 knots, while the core months bring 20&ndash;30 knots or more.</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Direction: The wind is typically side-shore to side-on shore from the southeast &mdash; reliable and good for both freeride and wave sessions. Conditions: The bay&rsquo;s shallow, reef-protected waters offer flat to small waves depending on tide and swell, making it great for all levels. We will stay at the best kitesurfing spots in Norther Madagascar. Sakalava Bay and the Emerald Sea.</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:cormorantgaramond-light,cormorantgaramond,cormorant garamond,serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:700;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:24px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Plan of the Trip</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:cormorantgaramond-light,cormorantgaramond,cormorant garamond,serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:700;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:24px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></span></span></span><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">20th - 25th of June</span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">5 night stay at Mada KIte Camp in Sakalava Bay.</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">We will stay in the sea view bungalows right on the kite spot</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">25th - 28th of June</span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">3 night stay at beautiful Tao Resort.at Emerald Sea in the bungalows facing the sea.</span></p>
<ul class="font_8 color_36 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Morning Yoga/Mobility Session 7:30/8:00</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Breakfast 8:30- 9:00</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Kite coaching session in the small groups with video making</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Lunch break</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Free time to practice those freshly learned tricks</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Dinner</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Video analysis of the coaching session</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Other activities<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
During our stay in Sakalava we will explore local wild life on the excursion to French Mountain located in Northern Madagascar. It is a premier spot for hiking, offering trails that showcase rare flora like baobabs and unique, diverse fauna such as lemurs, chameleons, and geckos. There will be also an optional full day tour to Amber Mountain beautiful high altitude<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
rainforst with stunning waterfalls and Red Tsingly the canyon&#39;s vibrant, colorful formations of red sandstone.</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">During our stay at Emerald Sea, we will do the boat trip to some stunning, hidden sandbanks.</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:cormorantgaramond-light,cormorantgaramond,cormorant garamond,serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:700;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:24px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Off the water activities</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:cormorantgaramond-light,cormorantgaramond,cormorant garamond,serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:700;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:24px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Madagascar is not just a kitesurfing destination, it&rsquo;s also a journey into nature and culture,<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
where you can explore&nbsp;</span></p>
<ul class="color_36 font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">French Mountain</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Amber Mountain</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Red Tsingy</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Admire iconic baobab trees</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Encounter Madagascar&rsquo;s unique lemurs in their natural habitat.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:cormorantgaramond-light,cormorantgaramond,cormorant garamond,serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:700;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:24px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Travelling and transfers</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:cormorantgaramond-light,cormorantgaramond,cormorant garamond,serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:700;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:24px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Most of the connections arrive to TNR in the afternoon, that&rsquo;s why most probably everyone will<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
require overnight stay in TNR. We recommend a layover in Nosy Manga hotel, close to the<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
airport. In the morning on the 20th you will take your local flight to Diego Suarez Airport where we pick<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
you up from.</span></p>
<ul class="color_36 font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Transfer from Diego Suarez airport to Madakitecamp hotel at Sakalava Bay on the 20th</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Transfer by car &amp; boat from Sakalava to Tao Resort at Emerald Sea on the 25th</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">28th Transfer Back from Tao to the airport by boat &amp; car</span></p>
</li>
